title: Trump Makes a Deal to Get Diesel Fuel From Russia
summary:
President Donald Trump says he has made a deal to bring Russian diesel fuel to the United States. Diesel is a fuel used by trucks, trains and farm machines.

Fuel prices in America have gone up a lot in recent months. The BBC says this is linked to a war involving Iran that began in February.

On Friday, Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed to send 300,000 tonnes of diesel right away, then 500,000 tonnes in November and another million tonnes later. The US is pausing some trade penalties, called sanctions, until April 7.

Not everyone thinks the plan will work. An expert named Tim Armitage said the first delivery is "relatively small" and will not change prices at the gas pump much.

Ukraine has been fighting against Russia's invasion. Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky called the deal a gift to Putin and said it "will not work for peace." The United Kingdom said it will keep supporting Ukraine.
why_it_matters: Fuel prices affect how much families pay for gas, food and other things they buy every day.
